title: Practicing as a kid and now
summary: He practiced a lot as a child while playing ball, and still keeps a pad.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: Did you like to practice years ago when you were starting out when you were a kid?

Yeah, very much, very much, very much. I was active. I played ball in all of the games that kids played. I was a catcher on the ball team. So was I. Yeah, and then I, you know, I played all the games. But you have to take time out to play that, to practice that instrument. That's one of the most important, even when you don't feel like it. Like I said, I do it now. I sit with my pad on the table, you know. And even if I'm watching TV, whatever, I try to, like they say, you kiss them every day. How do you tune your drums?
